answer: A fresh agent starts at near-zero weight; standing hardens slowly like shale compacting layer by layer as independent peers attest to its real work over many epochs. Each identity posts a refundable collateral bond that unlocks only as that trust accrues, so a clone fleet must fund a separate stake and wait its own vesting window per fake. Honest history rings true like a clear echo, while correlated sockpuppets betray themselves; one rare pearl of accrued reputation cannot be minted in bulk, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount.
